data.name: TranscodeVideoCodecInfo
data.value: What the camera sends is recorded untouched, which costs next to nothing. "Always H.264" decodes and encodes a camera that sends anything else (H.265, MJPEG) while it is recorded: the files then play in every player and browser, at the price of processor time for each such camera. Cameras that already send H.264 are not affected. Takes effect the next time a camera connects.

data.name: UseLowLatencyModeInfo
data.value: Enables optimised settings for minimal delay. Reduces buffer size and disables some processing to achieve near real-time video playback.

data.name: MaxLatencyMsInfo
data.value: Maximum allowed delay in milliseconds before the player skips frames to catch up. Lower values reduce delay but may cause stuttering on slow connections.

data.name: RtspTransportInfo
data.value: TCP is more reliable but may have higher latency. UDP is faster but packets may be lost on unstable networks.

data.name: BufferDurationMsInfo
data.value: Amount of video data to buffer before playback. Higher values provide smoother playback but increase delay. Set to 0 for minimal buffering in low latency mode.

data.name: OverrideSettingsInfo

data.name: MotionSensitivityInfo
data.value: Controls how easily motion is detected. Higher values detect smaller movements but may trigger false alerts from noise or lighting changes.

data.name: PostMotionDurationInfo
data.value: How many seconds to keep recording after motion stops. Ensures the full event is captured even if movement pauses briefly.

data.name: AnalysisFrameRateInfo
data.value: Number of frames analysed per second for motion. Higher values detect motion faster but use more CPU. Values between 5 and 15 are recommended.

data.name: AnalysisResolutionInfo
data.value: Resolution used for motion analysis. Lower resolutions are faster and use less CPU, while higher resolutions detect smaller objects more accurately.

data.name: CooldownSecondsInfo
data.value: Minimum wait time in seconds after a recording stops before a new motion-triggered recording can start. Prevents rapid on/off recording cycles.

data.name: BoundingBoxMinAreaInfo
data.value: Minimum size of a motion region before a bounding box is drawn. Larger values ignore small movements like insects or pixel noise.

data.name: VideoQualityInfo
data.value: Maximum video resolution for playback. Lower quality reduces bandwidth and CPU usage. 'Auto' uses the best quality available from the camera.

data.name: HardwareAccelerationInfo
data.value: Uses your graphics card (GPU) to decode video instead of the CPU. Significantly reduces CPU load and improves performance with multiple cameras.
